title.en: Query live streaming content moderation configurations

descriptions.zh:
- 先获取主播流域名，再调用本接口查询直播审核配置。本接口目前支持的排序方式为升序和降序。

- 目前仅部分直播中心支持直播智能审核，具体支持该功能的直播中心，请参见[服务地域](~~193730~~)。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Obtain the streamer streaming domain first, and then invoke this operation to query the content moderation configurations for live streaming. This operation supports sorting in ascending and descending order.

- Currently, only some live centers support intelligent content moderation for live streaming. For information about the live centers that support this feature, see [Service regions](~~193730~~).


## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 50 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, the API call is throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as needed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-snapshot-detect-porn-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --order Asc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveSnapshotDetectPornConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Order Asc --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --DomainName 'example.com' --AppName liveApp0000
